$comment: Which work states may illustrate which message. A flyer selling premium roofing must not show a worn-out roof: it reads as confusing at best and dishonest at worst. Keyed by campaign angle.

premium.why: Selling finished quality. A worn or half-stripped roof contradicts it.

upgrade.why: Showing the result the homeowner is buying.

proof.why: Showing the work. Finished, or genuinely underway.

emotional.why: Protection and pride. Not a damaged house.

trust.why: A crew working is credible; so is finished work.

offer.why: An offer is aspirational. Lead with the outcome.

problem.why: Naming a symptom. A worn roof is exactly the point.

urgency.why: Storm damage and emergencies show the damage.

unclassified.$comment: An image with no stage could be anything, including a tear-off. Treated as unusable wherever the message implies finished work, which is the fail-closed choice.

keywords.$comment: Filename tokens that establish a stage without a vision call.
